name: Bhima Bhoi Bhinnakshyama Samarthya Abhiyan
benefit:
Persons with Disabilities covered under the new Act include the following categories:

   1. Acid Attack Victim,
   1. Autism Spectrum Disorder,
   1. Blindness,
   1. Cerebral Palsy,
   1. Chronic Neurological Conditions,
   1. Dwarfism,
   1. Hemophilia,
   1. Hearing Impairment,
   1. Intellectual Disability,
   1. Leprosy Cured Person,
   1. Locomotor Disability,
   1. Low-Vision,
   1. Mental
